parts.text: As a dispatcher, I plan and run the flights by deciding which drone flies along which way, and I sign off each flight before it leaves. Several of us plan at the same time, often for the same busy sites and popular drones, and I can call off a flight. I need help finding out which of my drones could get to where a job starts, but the company's policy is that software never chooses a drone or a way for us.
